name: Admin Resource — Manage Resources
intent: Manage a set of resources (projects): find, compare, select and act.
user: Admin/operator managing a set of resources (projects).
primary_task: Browse, create, edit and delete resources with server-side validation.
secondary_tasks: Filter, sort and paginate the listing
success_state: The listing re-rendered after a successful mutation (POST + 303) showing the persistent success banner.
failure_recovery: 422 re-renders the form preserving values with inline alert + validation summary; missing resource renders error-state 404 with retry (R-ERROR-01/02).
no_js_flow: Complete: list state lives in the URL; create/edit/delete are POST + 303; delete is confirmed in a server-rendered <dialog open>; refresh reloads with an inline toast.
htmx_enhancement: hx-get swaps #resource-panel on sort/filter/page; refresh fragment + HX-Trigger loom:toast. Mutations stay POST + 303 (no hx-post).
